messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to the version where the person has blue hair and apply the following edit to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands facing the water, then slowly turns and shifts her weight while her arms swing slightly at her sides.","camera":"A medium shot from behind at roughly waist height, with a slight handheld drift and subtle reframing as she moves.","clothing":"A fitted black-and-white houndstooth dress with three-quarter sleeves, an open back, and a cutout at one shoulder.","hair_color":"Vivid blue.","hairstyle":"Short hair styled into two low pigtails or buns at the back of the head.","identity":"A woman with a slim build, seen from behind with her face turned away and not visible.","scene":"An outdoor concrete terrace or rooftop edge overlooking a calm sea under a clear, bright sky."},"uncertain":["The woman's face and facial features are not visible because she is shown from behind."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a road with trees, guardrail, and streetlight to a concrete terrace edge overlooking a calm sea under a clear sky. The woman remains seen from behind with blue hair in low buns/pigtails and the same black-and-white houndstooth dress, and her movement remains similar. The lighting on her appears brighter and more backlit, consistent with the new outdoor sea setting.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original roadside scene with the concrete terrace overlooking a calm sea shown in the reference, while preserving the woman's blue hair, hairstyle, houndstooth dress, action, camera framing/movement, and adapting her lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: The woman's face and expression are not visible, so facial preservation cannot be directly verified.
unexpected_changes: The output has black vertical bars on the left and right edges, changing the visible framing compared with the source.
